# FixtureShark

> FixtureShark (fixtureshark.com) is a UK sports data site: football results, tables and model predictions; Fantasy Premier League (FPL) projections and tools; club finances; the NFL; international football; and tennis. Every number comes from public data, and every model is tested against the betting market on games it has not seen.

All pages are free to read. Data is updated daily. UK times and UK TV channels are used throughout.

## Football (clubs)

- [Football hub](https://fixtureshark.com/football): fixtures, results, tables and predictions for English and European leagues.
- [Fixtures and results](https://fixtureshark.com/fixtures): every fixture with the model's prediction and the closing betting market beside it.
- [League histories](https://fixtureshark.com/football/leagues): every season's final table for each league held (the earliest from 1992/93).
- [Record book](https://fixtureshark.com/football/records): longest winning and unbeaten runs, biggest wins and season records.
- [What happened next](https://fixtureshark.com/football/history/what-happened-next): how teams in a given league position after N games finished, from history.
- [Team strength](https://fixtureshark.com/team-strength): attack and defence ratings and projected final tables.
- [Model scorecard](https://fixtureshark.com/football/model-scorecard): how the Dixon-Coles model's predictions compare with the closing market (log loss, by league and season).
- [UK TV guide](https://fixtureshark.com/tv-guide): which football is on UK television and on which channel.

## Fantasy Premier League

- [FPL hub](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/start): player projections, predicted line-ups, injuries, value and squad tools.
- [Player projections](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl): expected points per player for the next gameweeks.
- [Predicted line-ups](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/line-ups), [Minutes outlook](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/minutes), [Injuries](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/injuries), [Value](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/value), [Set pieces](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/set-pieces).
- [Player Scout](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/player-scout): every FPL player's season-by-season record.
- [Scoring rules](https://fixtureshark.com/fpl/scoring-rules): FPL's points rules for each season.

## Club finances

- [Club finances](https://fixtureshark.com/finance): revenue, wages, profit and debt for English clubs, from their filed accounts at Companies House.
- [Compare clubs](https://fixtureshark.com/finance/compare).

## International football

- [International hub](https://fixtureshark.com/international): every men's international since 1872.
- [Nations](https://fixtureshark.com/international/teams): each national team's record, Elo rating, tournament history and current squad.
- [Tournaments](https://fixtureshark.com/international/tournaments): every World Cup, Euro, Copa América, Africa Cup of Nations, Asian Cup, Gold Cup and Nations League edition with groups, brackets and scorers.
- [Through time](https://fixtureshark.com/international/history): the Elo top ten since 1872 and the biggest tournament upsets.

## NFL

- [NFL hub](https://fixtureshark.com/nfl): schedule, results, standings with official tie-breaks, and team pages since 2002.
- [UK TV guide](https://fixtureshark.com/nfl/tv-guide): how to watch each game in the UK (Sky Sports, DAZN, Channel 5).
- [Player projections](https://fixtureshark.com/nfl/player-projections): fantasy points projections for QB, RB, WR, TE and K.

## Tennis

- [Tennis hub](https://fixtureshark.com/tennis): ATP results since 2000 and WTA since 2007.
- [Players](https://fixtureshark.com/tennis/players): each player's record, titles, surface splits and form.
- [Tournaments](https://fixtureshark.com/tennis/tournaments): champions by year and every edition's draw.
- [Head to head](https://fixtureshark.com/tennis/head-to-head): any two players' meetings and a surface-adjusted win chance.
- [UK TV guide](https://fixtureshark.com/tennis/tv-guide).

## Methods

- Football predictions use a Dixon-Coles model fitted to past results; they are shown beside the closing betting market, and the scorecard reports how they compare.
- Team strength and projected tables use ratings implied by the betting market, which beat the Dixon-Coles model on unseen seasons (root-mean-square error of final points 8.42 v 9.45 in 2025/26).
- Tennis win chances come from surface-weighted Elo ratings plus ranking and head-to-head terms: on 31,944 matches in 2020-2026 the model picked the winner 64.8% of the time, against 68.1% for the bookmakers' favourite.
- The NFL model is a margin-based Elo; the international model is Poisson with a Dixon-Coles adjustment on Elo differences.

## Sources

football-data.co.uk (results and odds), the official Fantasy Premier League API, Companies House filings, nflverse (NFL), tennis-data.co.uk (tennis), Wikipedia (CC BY-SA; national squads), Wikidata (CC0; tennis player details) and the martj42 international results dataset.
